# Dependencies

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(plotrix)
library(ggstance)

```

# Load data and cleaning

```{r}

df <- read_csv("../data/round 3 - world cafe/worldcafe raw.csv") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(respondent_id, group, priority, sector_raw, rating)

# Priority labels (from numeric code)
priority_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Self Regulation & Co-Regulation",
  "2" = "Long-Term Effects",
  "3" = "Harms & Benefits",
  "4" = "Data Sharing",
  "5" = "Child Safety & Protection"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(priority_label = priority_labels[as.character(priority)])

# Domains
priority_domains <- c(
  "Self Regulation & Co-Regulation" = "Responsibility & Governance",
  "Long-Term Effects"               = "Game Design & Player Experience",
  "Harms & Benefits"                = "Game Design & Player Experience",
  "Data Sharing"                    = "Research & Data",
  "Child Safety & Protection"       = "Responsibility & Governance"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(domain = priority_domains[priority_label])

# Split multi-sector entries
df <- df %>%
  mutate(sector_raw = str_split(sector_raw, ";")) %>%
  unnest(sector_raw) %>%
  mutate(sector_raw = str_squish(sector_raw))

# -----------------------------
# 2. Convert rating to numeric
# -----------------------------
rating_scale <- c(
  "Not Yet Started" = 1,
  "Emerging"        = 2,
  "Early Progress"  = 3,
  "Established"     = 4,
  "Fully Achieved"  = 5
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(rating_num = rating_scale[rating])

# -----------------------------
# 3. Summaries
# -----------------------------
df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(domain, priority_label, sector_raw) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_rating = mean(rating_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rating = plotrix::std.error(rating_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(priority_label = case_when(
    priority_label == "Harms & Benefits" ~ "Harms\n& Benefits",
    priority_label == "Long-Term Effects" ~ "Long-Term\nEffects",
    priority_label == "Data Sharing" ~ "Data Sharing",
    priority_label == "Child Safety & Protection" ~ "Child Safety\n& Protection",
    priority_label == "Self Regulation & Co-Regulation" ~ "Self Regulation\n& Co-Regulation"
  )) 

#distinct(label_df, domain)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Force desired top-to-bottom order
# -----------------------------
# priority_order <- c(
#   "Harms & Benefits",
#   "Long-Term Effects",
#   "Data Sharing",
#   "Child Safety & Protection",
#   "Self Regulation & Co-Regulation"
# )

priority_order <- c(
  "Harms\n& Benefits",
  "Long-Term\nEffects",
  "Data Sharing",
  "Child Safety\n& Protection",
  "Self Regulation\n& Co-Regulation"
)

sector_order <- c(
  "Academic",			
  "Civil Society",				
  "Industry",
  "Other"
)

df_summary <- df_summary %>%
  mutate(
    priority_label = forcats::fct_rev(factor(priority_label, levels = priority_order)),
    #priority_label = factor(priority_label, levels = priority_order)
    sector_raw = forcats::fct_rev(factor(sector_raw, levels = sector_order))
  )

# Data frame for left-side text labels
label_df <- df_summary %>%
  distinct(priority_label, domain) |>
  mutate(domain = case_when(
    domain == "Game Design & Player Experience" ~ "Game Design\n& Player Experience",
    domain == "Research & Data" ~ "Research\n& Data",
    domain == "Responsibility & Governance" ~ "Responsibility\n& Governance"
  ))

# -----------------------------
# 5. Colours
# -----------------------------
sector_cols <- c(
  "Academic"      = "#8FA7CC",
  "Civil Society" = "#386DA6",
  "Industry"      = "#7B4F97",
  #"Government"    = "#52376B",
  "Other"         = "#12204D"
)

```

# Plot

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=12}

p <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = mean_rating, y = priority_label)) +

  # Dots for sector means
  ggstance::geom_linerangeh(aes(color = sector_raw,
                                xmin = mean_rating - se_rating*1.96, 
                                xmax = mean_rating + se_rating*1.96),
                            position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sector_raw), 
             size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sector_cols,
                     guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5,
    labels = c("Not Yet\nStarted", "Emerging",
               "Early\nProgress", "Established",
               "Fully\nAchieved")
  ) +

  labs(
    y = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    color = "Sector",
    title = "Current progress ratings across priorities by sectors",
    subtitle = "Dots show sector means ± 95% CI"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    # remove default y-axis labels (we draw our own)
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),

    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",

    # white background
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),

    # extra left margin for text columns
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off",
                  xlim = c(-3.75, 5.5)) +
  # # Domain labels (left column)
  # geom_text(data = label_df,
  #           aes(x = -2.5, y = priority_label, label = domain),
  #           hjust = 0,
  #           #fontface = "bold",
  #           size = 5) +
  # # Priority labels (second column)
  # geom_text(data = label_df,
  #           aes(x = -5.5, y = priority_label, label = priority_label),
  #           hjust = 0,
  #           #fontface = "bold",
  #           size = 5)
  # Domain labels (left column)
  geom_text(data = label_df,
            aes(x = -1.5, y = priority_label, label = domain),
            hjust = 1,
            #fontface = "bold",
            size = 5) +
  # Priority labels (second column)
  geom_text(data = label_df,
            aes(x = 0.25, y = priority_label, label = priority_label),
            hjust = 1,
            #fontface = "bold",
            size = 5)

p

# -----------------------------
# 7. Save with good proportions
# -----------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "../data/outputs/worldcafe_progress_ratings.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 13,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  filename = "../data/outputs/worldcafe_progress_ratings.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 13,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

```
